Ohio: what's on the November 3, 2026 ballot

Every candidate below is listed alphabetically, with party shown as text only. Open a name for their stated positions, background and recent news, each with sources.

Open Ohio on the map

Key dates

  • Voter registration deadline: October 5, 2026. County boards of elections and the Secretary of State's office stay open until 9 p.m. This deadline has passed.
  • Early in-person voting: October 6, 2026 to November 1, 2026. Remaining hours: Oct 23, 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; Oct 24, 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; Oct 26, 7:30 a.m.–7:30 p.m.; Oct 27, 7:30 a.m.–8:30 p.m.; Oct 28–30, 7:30 a.m.–7:30 p.m.; Oct 31, 8 a.m.–4 p.m.; Nov 1, 1–5 p.m. There is no early voting on Monday, Nov 2.
  • Last day to request an absentee (mail) ballot: October 27, 2026. Your county board of elections must receive the application by 8:30 p.m. Completed ballots must reach the board by 7:30 p.m. on Election Day (Nov 3). Military and overseas ballots can arrive by mail as late as Nov 7.
  • Election Day: November 3, 2026. Polls are open 6:30 a.m. to 7:30 p.m.

Official election information: Ohio Secretary of State

Who's running

Only the U.S. Senate and governor races are loaded so far. Other statewide offices, ballot measures, U.S. House and local races aren't loaded yet. Check your sample ballot for the full list.

Federal

United States Senate (Unexpired Term Ending 01/03/2029)

This special election fills the rest of the Senate term that ends January 3, 2029. Jon Husted, who was appointed to the seat in 2025, is running.

State

Governor and Lieutenant Governor

This is a four-year term starting January 11, 2027. It is an open seat because Governor Mike DeWine (R) is term-limited. Governor and lieutenant governor are elected together on one ticket. The running mates are David Pepper (with Amy Acton), Robert A. McColley (with Vivek Ramaswamy), and James L. Mills (with Don Kissick).
